english.title: Detain a child so as to keep him / her from a person having lawful control
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, detained **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a child under the age of 16, so as to keep

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

out of the lawful control of a person entitled to lawful control of the said child.
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 2(1)(b) and 4 of the Child Abduction Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See offence wording: H2067 - keep child from person having lawful control.
(ii) See similar offence wordings as follows: H2066 and H2073 where the child is taken/sent out of UK.
(iii) See offence wordings: H1650, H2065, H2299, H2086, H2295, H2296, H2297 and H2300 where the child is taken/detained from a person entitled to lawful custody, taken/detained from custody of person with lawful control, taken/kept while in care or incited to run away.
(iv) See section 2(2) for person to whom this offence does not apply.
(v) A person 'connected with a child' is defined in section 1(2).
(vi) An 'appropriate consent' is defined in section 1(3).

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
